section.title: Storing data
section.hierarchy_path: /Safety information/Safety information on storing and archiving/Storing data

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 2.10.1 Storing data
CAUTION

The internal identification of patient data, for example, studies, series and images, uses the system time for generation of the patient identification. If it is necessary to turn the system clock back, duplicate identifiers may be created!
Data may be assigned to wrong patient.
◆ If it is necessary to turn the system clock back for synchronization purposes, wait until the previous clock setting has been passed before creating new patient data.
CAUTION
Patient folders containing data from other patient or series, for example, after patient merge, import of data from external media!
The diagnosis or treatment may be made on the basis of incorrect information.
◆ Check that data is assigned to the correct patient and series before using the data.
CAUTION
Insufficient memory or disk space may lead to an instable or blocked system!
System is not available in emergency cases.
◆ Do not ignore the storage capacity warning icons.
◆ Do not ignore the warning message.
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
2 Safety information
CAUTION

Systems that do not use storage commitment only report back to the sending system when the data has been fully received (flags A and S). A user or an auto-delete mechanism at the sending system might subsequently delete the sent data. However, this response does not imply that the data has already been stored at the receiving system!
In the case that the receiving system cannot store the data, the data might irrevocably be lost.
◆ Double-check that the data is actually stored on the receiving system. Use storage commitment whenever it is supported by the sending and receiving systems.
CAUTION

Misleading or misinterpretation of the storage commitment flags AC/SC. Storage Commitment means storage to hard disk but this may not fulfill or guarantee regulatory requirements about long-term archiving. You can delete the committed objects!
Possible loss of data within the required period for retention.
◆ Observe the regulatory requirements regarding long-term archiving.
Pay attention to the storage capacity of the hard disk displayed by icons in the status bar of the task cards.
As soon as a predefined percentage of the storage capacity of the hard disk is reached, a warning icon is displayed in the status bar. The color of the icon depends on the storage capacity:
Yellow icon: If 75% of the storage capacity is reached
Red icon: If 90% of the storage capacity is reached

section.title: Laser lightmarkers
section.hierarchy_path: /System description/Scan unit (gantry)/Gantry operator panels/Gantry operator panel with Touch Panel/Laser lightmarkers

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Laser lightmarkers
This key turns on and off the laser lightmarkers.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
3 System description
The laser lightmarkers are laser beams that emanate from three marked points in the gantry opening. The laser beams create line marks. The beams can cross and create intersections.
The laser lightmarkers indicate the position of the scan center and the slice plane in the middle of the detector rows.
For interventional examinations, the laser lightmarkers are switched off automatically after approximately one minute.

You can optionally use the Auto Laser function to turn on or off the laser lightmarkers upon arriving at the start position. To activate the Auto Laser, in the settings popover on the Touch Panel go to General settings. ( Page 105 General settings)

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: RTP adaptor connections
For a standardized patient setup, the table top provides different mounting possibilities (indexing systems). ( Page 48 During system movements)
Slots along both sides of the RTP table top (for restraint straps)
Indentation (Interloc Indexing)
Bore hole
Plug connection for positioning aids
The indentations are used to mount adaptors.

The bore holes can be furnished with lens head screws. The screws are used to mount different accessories (for example, adaptors, rulers). The indexing systems are compatible with most of the accessories used in radiation therapy.
Screw sockets located on the foot end for external devices
For instructions using accessories see the instruction for use of the manufacturer.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 3.5.3 Workplace computer
One workplace computer is delivered with your system.
The pictures shown here are only examples. The appearance of your device may be slightly different.
You use this computer to perform the following activities:
Controlling the CT scanner
Evaluating studies
Storing studies
The workplace computer provides several components, for example, USB ports, DVD recorder. The location and the design of these components may vary.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
3 System description
Do not use the Computer On/Off key. The computer must be switched on and off by using control box and software only.

If you switch off the computer via the Computer On/Off key, it is not able to receive the start-up signal from the control box. In this case, you need to press the Computer On/Off key again to switch on the computer.
